Slices concatenated: intermittent (every 3rd AI.run throws, loop recovers), all-dead (KV+Vectorize+AI all unreachable, loop completes on degradation stubs), latency (30ms injected latency). Honest infrastructure under load that it names and survives = the honest-error archetype.
